text:
Maria G.: sharing a quick prototype for a compact trace playback bar — want thoughts on controls & a11y before we lock copy. screenshot: https://imgur.com/placeholder Erin (Design): looks good. 2 quick q's: 1) should Play/Pause be a circle primary CTA or a simple icon button in compact mode? 2) where does Export live — inline or under the kebab? Zach - Eng: from infra POV smaller is better. Icon-only Play/Pause with aria-label works. if we make it a primary button it's big and breaks compact density. Olivia PM: priority is discoverability for non-power users — export gets used a lot by support. maybe show Export (small icon + text) on hover and keep it under kebab by default? Erin (Design): hover-reveal could be fragile on touch. proposal: show a single Export icon in compact mode (no text), text appears in expanded view. export stays grouped with Share/Copy permalink inside kebab on mobile. kevin_sre: accessibility callout: keyboard focus order needs to be linear: Play -> Scrubber -> Time toggle -> Kebab. Also ensure aria-live updates when scrubber moves so screenreaders announce timestamp changes. Maria G.: noted. can we use aria-live="polite" on the timestamp region? Zach - Eng: yeah, aria-live="polite" for the current time readout works. for scrubber dragging we'll throttle announcements to once per 250ms. snippet: ```
00:12.2
``` Erin (Design): +1 on throttling. also text for the play button should be "Play trace" / "Pause trace" not just "Play" to clarify context for SRs. Olivia PM: what about correlation IDs — we currently show a short hash pill. Doubled requests sometimes mean multiple related IDs; support asks for copyable full ID. UX tradeoffs? kevin_sre: make pill show shortened ID with tooltip containing full ID and a copy button. keyboard-accessible tooltip is important. Example flow: Tab to pill -> Enter opens tooltip -> Copy action (aria-label="Copy correlation id"). Erin (Design): can we inline a small copy icon next to the pill for desktop so two clicks aren't needed? on mobile the tooltip pattern stays. Zach - Eng: inline copy icon increases click targets and is fine. We'll implement fallback to tooltip for narrow widths. Maria G.: copy text should default to full ID + trace permalink. want support to be able to paste both. suggested copy format: ` — ` Olivia PM: agreed. also tweak export copy: "Download trace (.har)" vs "Download snapshot"? which is clearer? Erin (Design): "Download snapshot" is ambiguous. "Download trace (HAR)" is precise for engineers, but non-technical PMs might be confused. maybe "Download trace snapshot (.har)" — explicit and friendly. kevin_sre: FYI we produce both HAR and JSON payloads in backend. UI should surface primary as HAR and a small chevron offering JSON. so label: "Download snapshot (.har)" and in badge "more: .json" Maria G.: decision checklist: 1) compact mode uses icon-only play/pause with aria-labels; 2) export icon visible in compact, full export + text in expanded; 3) export lives in kebab on mobile; 4) correlation pill shows short id + inline copy on desktop, tooltip copy on mobile; 5) timestamp uses aria-live polite & throttled announcements; 6) copy formats include trace id + permalink. anyone object? Erin (Design): no objections. I'll update mock and include a11y notes. Zach - Eng: we'll implement throttling + aria changes. PS — we should ensure continuous-batching traces (long traces) don't make scrubber lag. Might need virtualization on timeline ticks. kevin_sre: noted, I'll add perf test to the oncall checklist for long traces. tracebot: Deployed preview build to https://redwood-inference.dev/trace-preview/1967881234 (expires in 24h) :rocket: Maria G.: thanks — pairing review at 3pm today? Erin (Design): works for me. Zach - Eng: I'll be there. Olivia PM: same. kevin_sre: ping me if we need a quick audit after implementation. Maria G.: great, closing thread — Erin will post updated frames after the 3pm review. :white_check_mark:
